subject: POC: Clearlake Health — success criteria, evaluation plan & RACI
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@clearlakehealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Feb 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: POC recap and next steps — Clearlake Health

Hi Emily (and Carlos),

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have the same plan heading into the trial: 

Summary of what we agreed on
- Objective: Validate Redwood Inference as the primary LLM inference layer for Clearlake’s patient-facing triage assistant (reduce manual triage time by 40% and maintain safety/accuracy).
- Scope: 2-week POC against a representative subset of triage prompts (approx. 1k weekly users simulated); integration via API with your dev environment (staging).

Success criteria (agreed)
1) Latency: 95th percentile < 250ms for 1k concurrent sessions (staging infra).
2) Cost: token cost target <= $0.0009 per token equivalent for average workload (we’ll run cost sim).
3) Quality: Automated evals on our shared prompt set >= 92% pass on core medical-safety checks; no critical hallucination on high-risk prompts.
4) Stability: No >1% error rate across 2-week run.

Evaluation plan & timeline
- Week 0 (this week): Kickoff + infra checklist.
- Week 1: Integration and smoke tests; run initial 24h steady-state.
- Week 2: Load tests, automated evals, security checklist & procurement sign-off.
- Week 3: Final review + decisions on next steps (scale pilot or production).

Ownership & RACI (high level) — see attached detailed workbook, but key owners below:
- Infra (staging cluster + network): Clearlake infra owner (Carlos) – Responsible; Redwood (Aditya) – Support/Implement.
- App integration (API + auth): Clearlake dev lead (Emily) – Responsible; Redwood (Aditya) – Support.
- Security & compliance (data flows, retention): Clearlake security (TBD) – Responsible; Redwood security docs & SOC2 evidence – Accountable/Provide.
- Procurement/PO: Clearlake procurement (TBD) – Responsible; Marissa (Redwood) – Support.

Attachments I posted: clearlake_poc_plan_v1.pdf (plan & timeline) and clearlake_poc_raci.xlsx (detailed RACI & stakeholder mapping).

Immediate next steps
1) Can you confirm Carlos (infra) and procurement contact so we can loop them in?
2) Aditya will schedule the technical kickoff once we have infra contact and a staging endpoint (we can do as early as Mon).
3) I’ll start the internal purchase/PO conversation and share a draft SOW for you to review.

If that all looks good I’ll lock the kickoff for Monday 9am PT.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: clearlake_poc_plan_v1.pdf (PDF, 220KB)]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@clearlakehealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Mar 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC recap and next steps — Clearlake Health

Thanks Marissa — good summary. I dug into the infra/app/security split and sketched a concise RACI we can use in the kickoff. Pasting below so Emily/Carlos have quick visibility before we open the workbook.

Proposed RACI (concise)
- Infra (staging cluster, network ACLs, VPC peering if needed)
  - Responsible: Carlos Mendez (Clearlake infra lead)
  - Accountable: Clearlake CTO (Emily Zhang)
  - Consulted: Redwood SRE (Aditya Rao)
  - Informed: Marissa Cole (AE)

- App integration (API keys, auth, request routing, schema)
  - Responsible: Emily Zhang / Clearlake dev lead
  - Accountable: Emily Zhang
  - Consulted: Redwood SE (Aditya Rao)
  - Informed: Lauren Bishop (CS)

- Security & compliance (PHI handling, retention, audit logs)
  - Responsible: Clearlake Security (name TBD)
  - Accountable: Clearlake Security Officer / Emily for signoff
  - Consulted: Redwood Security (will provide SOC2 report + data flow docs)
  - Informed: Legal / Procurement

- Procurement & PO (contract, billing, SOW)
  - Responsible: Clearlake Procurement (TBD)
  - Accountable: Clearlake Finance
  - Consulted: Marissa Cole (Redwood AE)
  - Informed: Redwood Finance

Notes on technical ownership and handoffs
- Redwood will provide a short integration guide (auth, endpoints, sample payloads) and a sandbox API key for staging.
- For latency testing we recommend a small dedicated staging GPU with pinned throughput — Redwood can recommend instance sizes after we see expected QPS.
- For security evidence: attaching list of docs we’ll share during the kickoff (SOC2, data retention policy, network architecture).

I’ll schedule a 45-minute kickoff (technical + procurement align) for Mon 9am PT if that works for your team.

- Aditya
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: clearlake_poc_raci.xlsx (Excel, 12KB)]

From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@clearlakehealth.com>

Cc: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@clearlakehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 07:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: POC recap and next steps — Clearlake Health

Thanks Marissa and Aditya — this is helpful. Quick answers and follow-ups from our side: 

- Confirmed: Carlos is the infra owner and I’ll introduce him on the kickoff.
- Procurement contact: I’ll loop in Maria Lopez (procurement lead) on the kickoff thread; she handles smaller vendor POs.
- Security: Our security officer (Anand Patel) will be on the call for checklist items — he’ll want to review SOC2 evidence + data retention settings before we start any live data testing.

A couple of items to confirm ahead of kickoff:
1) Can Redwood provide a short checklist of required staging ports / IPs and an expected sample rate so Carlos can prep the network team?
2) For the quality evals, can you confirm the automated eval framework you’ll run and whether we can review the prompt set prior to the run?

If those are fine we’re good for Mon 9am PT. I’ll add Maria and Anand to the invite once you confirm.

Emily
CTO | Clearlake Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: POC recap and next steps — Clearlake Health

Perfect — thanks Emily. I’ve invited Maria and Anand to the kickoff (calendar invite attached). Aditya — below are quick answers to Emily’s two asks so Carlos can prep: 

- Network checklist (high level):
  - IP allowlist: Redwood staging egress IPs (will provide in invite)
  - Ports: outbound 443 (HTTPS) for API; optional 22 for debugging if agreed; no inbound firewall changes required on your side for standard API flow.
  - Estimated sustained QPS for test: 25 QPS steady-state for baseline; peak 80 QPS during load window.

- Eval framework: Redwood will run automated evals using our internal scoring harness (unit tests + scorecards) — we’ll share the prompt set and scoring rubric ahead of Week 2 load run for you to review and annotate.

Attachments: clearlake_poc_plan_v1.pdf, clearlake_poc_raci.xlsx (linked in this thread).

Next: Kickoff scheduled Mon 9am PT (calendar invite). Aditya — please share the staging IPs and the sandbox key in the meeting. Lauren — once we have confirmation of procurement contact (Maria) can you start onboarding tasks for trial success metrics tracking?

Thanks all,
Marissa
